title: fix_signal: no fallback guidance when read_file result exceeds token limit
description: When .moeb/signals/index.md was too large for read_file, the agent fell back to external tools (Grep, Read) instead of moeb grep_files and read_file_range. The Signal Resolution Mode section instructs reading index.md but does not specify how to handle oversized reads, causing a moeb-tool-origin rubric failure.
proposed_resolution: Add a note to the Signal Resolution Mode section of fix_signal.skill.md: when read_file returns a too-large result, use grep_files to search for the signal ID, then read_file_range to extract the row.
